ns2:course.label: Comp Theory and Practice
ns2:course.description: History and theory of written composition; basic rhetorical principles; and guidance and criticism of student writing. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One year of college literature or consent of instructor.
